AUTHOR: Marrable
TITLE: Accelerating Species Recognition and Labelling of Fish From Underwater Video With Machine-Assisted Deep Learning
REGION: Australia (OzFish BRUVS, various habitats; out-of-sample RUV datasets from Queensland seagrass/estuaries)
SPECIES: 12 most abundant OzFish species incl. Lethrinus punctulatus, Lutjanus sebae, plus catch-all 'fish' class
DATA: OzFish subset (1,751 images, 42,685 boxed fish; 5,112 species-labelled) for training; out-of-sample: DeepFish (1,600 localisation images), Dataset A (Lopez-Marcano 2021), Dataset B (Ditria 2021), Dataset C (Lopez 2021)
V_EV: Results 3.1: 'the model identifying fish against backgrounds of a range of habitat types (such as seagrass, sand, and coral) and in a range of water conditions and clarities'
D2: 66/17/17 train/val/test stratified by class (OzFish box-and-labelled subset)
D_EV: no statement found (Methods 2.3: 'The box-and-labelled data were split into train, validation, and test sets with 66%, 17%, and 17% by class, respectively.' - unit/randomness not stated)
R_EV: Methods 2.3: 'the model detection was applied to four completely independently collected and published, out-of-sample datasets'; Table 2 recall OzFish 0.699 vs A 0.701, B 0.885
C_EV: Sec. 2.4.2: 'All models were given a confidence threshold of 0.5, meaning any predictions with a confidence less than 0.5 were ignored.'
E_EV: Table 2 / Table 3 report only Precision, Recall and F1 for fish-only detection and 12-species classification
ARCH: YOLOv5-large (ultralytics), transfer learning; fish-only detector and 12-species + fish detector
METR: Precision, recall, F1 (OzFish test); recall only on out-of-sample datasets (DeepFish, A, B, C)
NOTE: Split of OzFish frames is stratified 'by class' with no mention of video-level separation, so coded as image-level split (unit not explicitly stated as random). Out-of-sample tests are on independent RUV (unbaited) datasets from other habitats; only recall could be computed (no FP assessment possible), R3 = Y because per-dataset recall is reported. Fixed default 0.5 threshold; false positives are discussed qualitatively (catch-all fish class reduces FP) but no threshold sensitivity or verified FP rate, so C_ALL = N. No ecological variable derived (E1 = 없음). CODE = Y refers to the published data-preparation Jupyter notebook (GitHub AutomatedFishID), not model weights. Platform mixed: training on BRUVS (OzFish), testing on RUV datasets.
